answer: An operator copying one text across 67 aliases hence pays for 67 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. Since the reef hash is stored at intake, the mirror graph groups the endorsements and the wander audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 7 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
